# Alfred - Contract Intelligence for Large-Scale Construction Projects
Alfred (alfredworks.ai) reads construction tenders and contracts, surfaces
the risks a bid team would miss, tracks every contractual obligation against
the schedule and site progress, and drafts notices, RFIs, EOT and claim
letters for a human to review and send. Alfred never auto-sends.

## What Alfred does
Bid risk review (pre-contract) · obligation & risk tracking (post-contract) ·
claims and EOT drafting · time-bar deadline alerts · document control (DocuHub)

## Who it's for
EPCs and general contractors, project owners, and PMCs on large-scale
projects in India and the Middle East.

## Standards Alfred reads against
FIDIC (Red, Yellow, Silver, Green) · CPWD GCC · NHAI · Metro Rail · internal standards
